decision: made the frame loop generic over FrameSink
why: root ordering must work for any ordered frame consumer
result: fake sink receives ordered frames from out-of-order mock completions

decision: replaced FFmpeg-specific root cleanup with trait-level abort
why: root retains the primary renderer or write failure while sink cleanup is secondary
result: root no longer calls FFmpeg-specific abort helpers

decision: used active finished and aborted sink states
why: child ownership must remain active until finalization or abort resolves
result: constructor failures, abort, finish wait failure, and Drop use explicit cleanup paths

why: an encoded file with fewer frames must not become the final output
